name: Mount Meru to Socialist Peak
why: The second mountain of Tanzania: past giraffes and buffalo in the forest, then a sharp ridge around a broken crater with Kilimanjaro floating at sunrise.
book: Arusha National Park fees and hut fees. An armed park ranger is compulsory: book through an operator in Arusha. Huts at Miriakamba and Saddle.
dangers: Buffalo and elephant in the lower forest: stay with the ranger.
The summit ridge is narrow and steep, with drops into the crater.
turnaround: Leave Saddle Hut at 01:00 and turn back at 08:00 wherever you are.

points.name: Momella Gate
points.note: The gate in Arusha National Park; giraffe often graze near the road.

points.name: Miriakamba Hut
points.note: Huts at 2,500 m in the forest, below the crater wall.

points.name: Saddle Hut
points.note: Huts at 3,570 m on the saddle between Little Meru and the summit ridge.

points.name: Socialist Peak
points.note: The 4,566 m summit on the crater rim, Kilimanjaro on the eastern horizon.
